name: aje-poc-qwik
description: Al Jazeera English PoC — Qwik 2 (beta) implementation

scripts.build: bun --bun vite build && bun --bun vite build --ssr ./src/entry.ssr.tsx && bun --bun vite build --ssr ./src/entry.preview.tsx
scripts.test: PUBLIC_LIVEBLOG_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=500 PUBLIC_API_BASE=http://localhost:4456 bun run build && SNAPSHOT_INDEX=0 vitest run
scripts.test:acceptance: PUBLIC_LIVEBLOG_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=500 PUBLIC_API_BASE=http://localhost:4456 bun run build && SNAPSHOT_INDEX=0 vitest run tests/acceptance.test.ts
